evals.name: notice-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: A session-start notice said the explainer-video Python packages could not be installed. Is it working?
evals.expected_output: Runs pydeps.py check with --data-dir and reports its PASS/FAIL rows. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Runs pydeps.py check rather than assuming the state
Does not run the repair line, pip or a package manager unasked

evals.name: install-only-on-request
evals.prompt:
/explainer-video:check

ManimCE failed. Install it for me.
evals.expected_output: Runs the repair line the check printed, which installs the hash-locked set in the foreground, because the user asked. Does not install system packages such as cairo or pango development libraries.
expectations: Uses the repair line from the check output, not pip install or uv
Does not run apt, brew, winget or another system package manager
Re-runs the check after the repair line and reports the result

evals.name: passing-check-stops
evals.expected_output: Reports the rows. When every row passes, says the plugin is ready and stops.
expectations: Reports PASS rows for Python, ManimCE, ffmpeg and ffprobe when they resolve
